items.title: Reproduce the INIT-window data-loss in a regression smoke (create story in INIT, simulate a concurrent git clean -fd / wrong-branch checkout on the shared checkout, assert metadata is currently lost)
items.context: Lock the bug before fixing (systematic-debugging Phase 1/4). The smoke must fail on current main (metadata gone) so the fix is provably what closes it. Use a temp git repo fixture with the real .gitignore allowlist.
items.userSees: Running lattice validate shows the new smoke: it FAILS on current main (the simulated concurrent git clean -fd wipes the INIT metadata) and PASSES after the fix, printing "✓ init-window data-loss smoke passed: INIT metadata survives concurrent git clean -fd on the shared checkout".

happy.desc: Smoke creates a story in INIT, simulates a concurrent git clean -fd on the shared checkout, and on current main asserts the metadata files are gone (reproduces the bug)

edge.desc: Smoke covers both the allowlisted-not-ignored leaf (.lattice/story/actives/**) and an ignored leaf, since clean -fd vs clean -fdx differ

adversarial.desc: Smoke asserts actual metadata file bytes present/absent (not just an exit code), so a no-op fix cannot make it falsely pass

items.title: Create the safe-init-commit at story_create so INIT metadata is a durable clean-proof git object from birth
items.context: Extract/reuse the bootstrap safe-init-commit (force-add + commit-tree/update-ref) and invoke it at the end of story_create under the already-held main-write-lock. Decide commit target (story branch ref vs main) in PLAN; ensure INIT_CHECK bootstrap is idempotent when the ref/commit already exists, and story_discard --purge still reverses it.

items.title: Extend the B-854c protection predicate so any !tracked metadata leaf is flagged (not only ignored && !tracked), and surface it in doctor
items.context: story-metadata-protection.ts: the unsafe predicate must catch the allowlisted-but-uncommitted state (!ignored && !tracked) that the INIT window sits in. Update doctor scan + the warning text. Keep the existing ignored && !tracked case.
items.userSees: lattice doctor now reports an uncommitted INIT metadata leaf as "⚠ DATA-LOSS RISK: story metadata is NOT git-tracked" even when the leaf is allowlisted-not-ignored (the INIT window), not only when ignored.

happy.desc: evaluateStoryMetadataProtection flags unsafe=true for the !ignored && !tracked (allowlisted-but-uncommitted) state

edge.desc: Still flags the original ignored && !tracked case; a tracked leaf remains safe (unsafe=false) regardless of ignore state

adversarial.desc: Blank/whitespace leaf path is rejected (throws), so no consumer can classify an empty path as safe; doctor surfaces the new case without false-positiving a correctly committed leaf
